results.label: this tree ships the zone-method vocabulary and the consolidation walk (src/bots/smc.js) (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
the probe renders payloads the server really sent: the default read, an honoured request, and a request the app cannot honour
and a stored choice is a state the server distinguishes from a request (the source token travels with it)
the bots screen names the geometry the read ran on, in words that say which of the two Ep 7 methods it is
and it points at the other choice where the trader can make it, rather than making it for him
the default read is named as the default (nobody chose), not attributed to a decision the trader never made
a range read says so, with the number of zones actually plotted that way (the slice on screen is not the whole read)
a request the app cannot honour prints the app’s own sentence naming what it can plot, so the picture and the sentence agree
and the screen still says which geometry it DID use rather than leaving the zones unattributed
zones whose consolidation could not be walked are counted on screen as having stayed pivot, never silently dropped
a read that never reached the zone stage says NOTHING: it does not name a method it did not use
the note is explanation, not a second decision surface: it carries no control of its own
and the method note does not disturb the M26 window note or the M56 plan note beside it
the Settings pane offers the zone method as a named choice with its own control
it offers the CLOSED vocabulary: the pivot default and the range method, and nothing else
and an unset choice preselects NOTHING the trader never made: the empty (default) option is the selected one
the note states the trade-off in words that name both methods and where the numbers differ (the stop behind a wider zone)
saving sends the chosen method on the settings route the app already has (the screen and the stored row cannot drift)
and the save still carries the fields that were already on that form, so choosing a geometry cannot silently drop a preference
and the stored choice is preselected on the next visit, so the screen never loses a decision the trader made

scope: M30 real DOM: the zone-method choice and the geometry every screen names: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
